landing.metaDescription: A teacher's personal workspace: subjects, classes, units, resources and planning, with an assistant that knows what they teach.
landing.heroTitle: Everything you need to run your teaching, in one place.
landing.heroSubtitle: EduHub is not a file folder. It is your workspace as a teacher: your subjects, classes, units, resources and planning, with an assistant that knows what you teach.
landing.heroNote: Works in Arabic and English, on computer, tablet and phone.
landing.whatBody: A personal workspace that brings together teaching, organising materials, resources, planning, search and AI. Every subject has its classes, every class its two semesters, every semester its units, and every unit its videos, files, slides, plans and worksheets. Four clicks take you to anything.

organize.title: Organised materials
organize.body: Subject, grade, semester, unit, then resource sections. When you upload a file, EduHub suggests its place, and you decide.

classes.title: Your own classes
classes.body: The workspace is built on your subjects and grades. Add a class, a unit or a section whenever you need one.

quick.title: Search and quick access
quick.body: One search across all your subjects and units, plus favorites and recently used.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.body: Writes a lesson plan, a quiz or a worksheet, and knows the subject, grade and unit you are in.

bilingual.title: Arabic and English
bilingual.body: The whole interface flips between right-to-left and left-to-right, not just the text.

devices.title: Phone and computer
devices.body: The same experience on every screen, and installable as an app on your phone.

planning.title: Planning
planning.body: Lesson plans and worksheets live in their unit, and what the assistant writes is reviewed and saved next to them.

1.title: Create your account
1.body: Three short steps and you are in your space.

2.title: Pick your subjects and grades
2.body: Your classes are created with their semesters and units.

3.title: Organise your resources
3.body: Upload files or paste links inside the unit and section.

4.title: Start teaching
4.body: Open what you need in class from any device.

landing.showTitle: A workspace you understand at first glance
landing.showBody: After you log in you see your own subjects and classes, your quick actions and what you worked on last.
landing.aiTitle: An assistant that knows your classes
landing.aiBody: Ask from any page. Inside a unit of Grade 6 it already knows that, and with a PDF in front of you it can answer questions about its content.

aiPoints.1: Lesson plans, quizzes, worksheets, flashcards and summaries.
aiPoints.2: What it writes is a draft: preview it, edit it, then save it as a new note.
aiPoints.3: It never changes or deletes your original files.

landing.aiDemoAsk: Write a lesson plan on the Present Perfect
landing.aiDemoAnswerBody: Objectives, warm-up, presentation, guided practice, assessment and homework.
landing.devicesBody: Designed for the phone first, then scaled up. No sideways scrolling, no tiny buttons.

desktop.title: Computer
desktop.body: Sidebar, drag and drop between sections, and a wide preview.

tablet.title: Tablet
tablet.body: Comfortable for presenting in class and for touch.

mobile.title: Phone
mobile.body: Bottom navigation and large buttons, installable as an app.

landing.trustBody: Your teaching and personal data deserve care. This is what the platform does today:

private.title: Your resources are yours
private.body: Every resource is private by default, and only your account can open your files.

passwords.title: Passwords are never stored as typed
passwords.body: They are hashed with scrypt and nobody can view them. The national ID is stored encrypted and only its last four digits are shown.

sessions.title: Control over devices
sessions.body: Each device has its own session that you can see and close. "Remember me" applies only to the device you chose it on.

trash.title: No accidental deletion
trash.body: What you delete goes to the trash and can be restored. Permanent deletion asks for confirmation.

codes.title: Real verification codes
codes.body: Resetting your password and changing your email use a 6-digit code sent to your inbox, valid for minutes and for one use.

landing.finalTitle: Start building your digital teaching space.
landing.footerTagline: One workspace for everything a teacher needs.

about.title: About
about.body: EduHub is a teacher's personal workspace. It keeps their subjects, classes, units and teaching resources in one place, with an AI assistant for preparation.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: To reach the organisation that runs this platform, use the contact published here.

help.title: Help
help.body:
To start: create an account and you are taken straight to your space.

If you forget your password: on the log-in page choose "Forgot your password?", enter the code sent to your email, and choose a new one.

To reach your resources: My classes, then the class, the semester, the unit, and the section.

To add a resource: open the section and press "Add", then choose a file or paste a link.

To move a resource: drag it to another section on a computer, or open it and choose "Move" on a phone.
